steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Advertising is a paid form of persuasive communication that aims to promote products, services, or ideas to target audiences through various media platforms. | Key Fact: Marketing encompasses the broader strategy of identifying, anticipating, and satisfying customer requirements profitably — advertising is one tool within the marketing mix. | Key Fact: Persuasive techniques include: emotional appeal, fear, humour, celebrity endorsement, bandwagon (everyone's doing it), testimonials, rhetorical questions, and superlatives ('the best'). | Key Fact: AIDA model: Attention (grab the audience), Interest (hold it), Desire (create want), Action (prompt purchase). Most adverts follow this structure.
